comparison.objective: Hold a servo motor while inserting its cable during robot-arm assembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization and electrical connector alignment/insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Cable inserted into the held servo; setup and scoring fields are explicitly missing.
comparison.reason: Despite shared bimanual stabilization and fine alignment, connector mating tests insertion rather than impact fracture, retained-coil safety, tool withdrawal, and fragment recovery.
